TradeReference.name: Trade Reference
TradeReference.definition: Unique identification assigned to a trade. This is the reference generated by a firm or the reference allocated by the executing system if the trade was executed automatically.

AssociatedTradeReference.name: Associated Trade Reference
AssociatedTradeReference.definition: Reference that links to other trades that are/will be sent, eg for straddles where put and call legs need to be reported together.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Identifies the execution venue. In the case of an exchange or a Multilateral Trading Facility (MTF), this should be identified using a MIC code. In the case of a systematic internaliser, place of trade should be identified using a BIC code.

TradeDateTime.name: Trade Date Time
TradeDateTime.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Provides details of the financial instrument for which the transaction report is being sent.

Side.name: Side
Side.definition: Identifies whether the transaction was a buy or a sell from the perspective of the reporting firm.

TransactionReportMarker.name: Transaction Report Marker
TransactionReportMarker.definition: Identifies the regulator(s) to whom the transaction report must be sent.

Capacity.name: Capacity
Capacity.definition: Identifies the trading capacity of the firm reporting the transaction, eg Agent or Principal.

ExecutedTradePrice.name: Executed Trade Price
ExecutedTradePrice.definition: Specifies the currency and price at which the trade has been executed, excluding commission or accrued interest.

ExecutedTradeQuantity.name: Executed Trade Quantity
ExecutedTradeQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument executed by the trading party.

ProxyHolder.name: Proxy Holder
ProxyHolder.definition: Provides details of the person/organisation that has the power of attorney.

ClientRule.definition: If Capacity is Agent (AGEN), then Client must be present.
